usage: OFFLINE DESIGN CATALOG ONLY. Mnemonic candidates are not clinical evidence or validated recall aids. No production prompt injection or image generation is enabled by this file. Clinical facts must come through Forge source retrieval. Evidence is per-entry and context-specific; empty evidence means untested. Generic designs may independently overlap common vocabulary; no proprietary scenes or signature character systems were imported.

sources.purpose: General design principles only; no concrete symbols or scenes reused.
General pairing of imagery, narration and retrieval practice; not evidence for our entries.
Public description of visual mnemonics only; main site returned403; no catalog scraped.
Study of another audiovisual system, not validation of Mnemorized, individual cues or image-generation reliability.
